history.summary: Large 990 sqft 2BR in a mature waterfront D15 development with a TEL catalyst at Tanjong Rhu, but priced at $1,515 PSF against a $1,663 URA median with only 3.6% appreciation. A liquid, well-known name with deep transaction history, but middling growth and an ageing 99-yr lease cap the upside.
history.rating_rationale: Listing PSF $1,515 sits ~9% below the $1,663 URA median (room for value), and 131 txns give high liquidity confidence. But 3.56% appreciation is below the RCR baseline, the unit is oversized for a 2BR (990 sqft inflates absolute price to $1.5M), and 1998 99-yr lease has ~71 years remaining and erodes from here.
red_flags: 990 sqft is large for a 2BR, lifting entry price
